contexts.text: Everyone is such as is his reigning love... [Swedenborg footnote 1.]. That the reigning love with everyone is in each and all things of his life, thus in each and all things of his thought and will. References.
Before the face is always that love which reigns... Explained.
They thence know his reigning love, in which are all things in their order.
They perceive from the sound... his reigning love...
His face becomes like his reigning love...

It is the reigning love which awaits man after death; nor is it changed to eternity. Everyone has many loves, but they all relate to his reigning love, and make a one with it; or, together, compose it. All things of the will which agree with the reigning love are called loves, because they are loved...
There is an extension into heavenly Societies if the reigning love consists of loves of Heaven; and into infernal Societies if the reigning love consists of loves of Hell.
When an Angel goes away from his own Society... he feels a constant longing to return to his like, thus to his reigning love.
After death are taken away from him the things which do not make a one with his reigning love...
All Spirits can be led... if they are kept in their reigning love...
That the spirit of a man is his reigning love...
That man... remains to eternity such as he is as to his... reigning love. Explained.
All the delights which man has are of his reigning love...
For the reigning love of one is not in all respects like that of another...
To know one's reigning love is impossible to those who are in the love of self...
As soon as he is brought into his reigning love, he vanishes... and is with those in the Society to which he has been attached.
That every Spirit... turns himself to his reigning love. General article.
That the reigning love with its concupiscences... is as the devil is in Hell.
Then the reigning love is allotted the highest place...
The things which are from its reigning love are in the middle...
He then remains... such as is his reigning love...
In the same proportion he enlarges the court of his reigning love...
The life's love, which is the reigning love, awaits everyone after death, and cannot be taken away.
The seed... is the form of the father's reigning love, with its proximate derivations...
At last (the child) comes to the reigning love of his father...
The spiritual state is such that no one can be anywhere else than where his reigning love is... DP 319:end.
All after death become affections of their reigning love...
Their externals are put off in succession... even until the reigning love... is revealed.
The reigning affection itself shines from the Angels' faces; and garments are allotted them accordingly.
The reigning love, which is the head of all the rest, remains with everyone to eternity; and, with it, the subordinate loves together. Explained.
Therefore he who Knows anyone's reigning love... Knows the whole man.
If the love of the world... is the reigning love...
For all the evil is... an image of his reigning love...
But those not fully vastated... do not turn constantly to their reigning love... AE 78:4.
a. Everyone there, wherever he may appear, is still in that place where is his reigning love...
That every man is in his own reigning love; and is thus as it were in a centre.
Therefore, when a Spirit has been reduced to his reigning love ways open to the Society where his love reigns.
This delay is in order that the affections... may be reduced to the reigning love; so that the Spirit may be his whole love.
For the reigning affection with man is from his father; for it is his soul; but with the Lord it was...
The reigning love of the parents... is transcribed into the offspring, and becomes its nature...
The reigning love is that which turns (the interiors upwards, or downwards).
He then turns his face to the Society where is his reigning love... LJPost 244.
